svg.content: (Durable Backlog)" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=15;fillColor=#9C27B0;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_db">(Flush theo interval)" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=15;fillColor=#9C27B0;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_db">(Hysteresis Check: Free > 0)" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#2196F3;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_engine">= MaxInFlight - Current" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FF9800;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_engine">Claim đúng số Free Slots" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FF9800;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_engine">(Non-blocking Send Stream)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#2196F3;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_engine">(Lock-free Ring Buffer / Virtual Threads)" style="shape=hexagon;perimeter=hexagonPerimeter2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=0.1;fillColor=#E91E63;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_engine">(Xả DB định kỳ & Giải phóng slot)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#4CAF50;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_engine">Multi-Partition Parallel" style="shape=hexagon;perimeter=hexagonPerimeter2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=0.15;fillColor=#009688;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="col_kafka">

g.text: (Xả DB định kỳ & Giải phóng slot)
